Lately I’ve been feeling lost without my family and my little sidekick at my side. I’ve been spending time trying to figure out my physical signs and mental/emotional state. I stumbled on this Sister Circle through a link from a link a friend gave me. I had a feeling it was going to be important. The meditation led me to my family, a sense of a special closeness just like I had in my first mindfulness meditation where I connected with my little baby in my tummy for the first time- so close I could sense my breath on her skin. In the meditation I basked in the moonlight with my little girl, and laughed and played on the beach in my hometown with her and my husband. Literally Life changing!! ✨ 🌝 🦉 ✌️ @alihwellness

We are not green fingered by any means, we don’t have a garden or a space in our personal living area for plants, but these are on the landing window sill, north facing and this poppy was a gift from the local community hub. We weren’t sure if it would be ok, I think I offered too much water at the start or maybe the sun blanched her leaves a little. We noticed a few buds appearing last week and yesterday one opened. Today the second opened. There’s nothing like the surprise of a new bloom as you head to the kitchen first thing in the morning.

Favourite time of year. I’m finally feeling like I Need to be out there again, feeling like being a kid in the park again and really getting outside for my own needs not just my daughter’s. Motherhood the first few years has been challenging, but this third year is looking brighter and I have more energy and general go even on the wet days we’ve had, getting caught in the rain showers was fun and more fun when a little one finds it fun!

Today we did another activity from @mudnbloom box. Batik dye eggs. We’ve had a visit from my niece and nephew who were up for this one and the eating at teatime! We used some mint leaves from a plant in the kitchen and whiled away some rainy day time. The colours were awesome and they were impressed by the leaf detail left on the eggshell by the leaf.

Ere looking forward to adding things we discover on our walks outside, tying or weaving them in. We’ve really enjoyed this box, it’s our first time and has had us appreciating this season and being a bit more creative in it. Owl was impressed!!

We’re so happy with our first pair of @sillysilas_kidsclothing tights with braces that we have a couple more pairs to keep us going. They’re 100% organic cotton, have loads of room for growing, are super soft and hard wearing, my little one tells me every time she puts them on how soft they are. Unisex, great for layering and any kind of activity, perfect as a base layer in colder weather, BUT most of all they stay up!! Most trousers that have the length are too big in the waist and immediately fall down so these are a great answer to that problem. I just thought I’d share in case your little one has the same issue with trousers or tights and your looking at options besides braces. These are new shades liquorice peanut and creamy olive, we also have the older colour, same design, fig, but all the colours are lovely natural shades and look good with anything. just sharing a solution to our problem, not advertising

I used to think that “self care” was all money-spinning nonsense until very recently through research and care I’ve discovered a way to actually find things that work for me. They’re all natural and low or zero when it comes to plastic. They’re plant based and have really actually done what they said they would. They have rave reviews and the owners of the companies are super passionate about my health as well as the planet. It may not be like this for everyone but I seriously want you to know that if something you are using on your body isn’t serving you or doesn’t sit well with you spiritually, then do some research and switch those things out and replace them. Start the day with real CARE for yourself and it will really effect the rest of it.
